description: Na₂PdH₄ crystallizes in the tetragonal I4/mmm space group. There are four inequivalent Na¹⁺ sites. In the first Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded in a body-centered cubic geometry to eight equivalent H¹⁻ atoms. All Na-H bond lengths are 2.48 Å. In the second Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded in a body-centered cubic geometry to eight equivalent H¹⁻ atoms. All Na-H bond lengths are 2.48 Å. In the third Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded in a body-centered cubic geometry to eight equivalent H¹⁻ atoms. All Na-H bond lengths are 2.48 Å. In the fourth Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded in a body-centered cubic geometry to eight equivalent H¹⁻ atoms. All Na-H bond lengths are 2.48 Å. There are two inequivalent Pd²⁺ sites. In the first Pd²⁺ site, Pd²⁺ is bonded in a square co-planar geometry to four equivalent H¹⁻ atoms. All Pd-H bond lengths are 1.64 Å. In the second Pd²⁺ site, Pd²⁺ is bonded in a square co-planar geometry to four equivalent H¹⁻ atoms. All Pd-H bond lengths are 1.64 Å. H¹⁻ is bonded to four Na¹⁺ and one Pd²⁺ atom to form a mixture of corner, edge, and face-sharing HNa₄Pd square pyramids.
